_note: Editor corrections applied by scripts/build-data.mjs on top of Open Halalan. Every entry says why. Never hand-edit data/officials.json; change this file and run `npm run data`. Reported upstream: https://github.com/RobertRLeung/OpenHalalan/issues/5 (remove a correction once the source is fixed; build-data fails loudly when a placeFix no longer matches).

mergedSlates.reason: Open Halalan files the 2010 and 2013 Malaybalay City winners under Cabanglasan (two mayors and two vice mayors per year, and no Malaybalay rows). Each winner is placed by where they held office in other years.

Open Halalan files the 2010 and 2013 Valencia City winners under Talakag (two mayors and two vice mayors per year, and no Valencia rows). Each winner is placed by where they held office in other years.
Some municipal winners have no city or municipality in Open Halalan, mostly Malitbog. Each winner is placed by where they held office in other years.

assign.name: Jose Maria R. Zubiri Jr.
assign.reason: The source spells his name five ways ("Jose Ma. Jr. R.", "Jose Ma. Maria", "Jose Maria", "Jose Rubin", "Jose Maria Jr.") and uses "Jose Ma. Maria" for his son as well. Governor 2001–2010 and 2013–2022, vice governor 2010–2013 and 3rd district representative from 2022 (MindaNews 2016-05-10, 2022-05-10).

assign.name: Jose Maria "Joey" Zubiri III
assign.reason: These representative rows carry the same name as the governor, who was serving as governor at the time. MindaNews (2016-05-10) says Manuel Zubiri "will replace his brother, Joey Zubiri, who is on his third term" in the 3rd district.
